fields.name: Arjun Reddy
fields.text: The Mutton Pulav at Godavari Vindu is the finest I've had outside my grandmother's kitchen. The spices are perfectly balanced and the meat just falls off the bone.

fields.name: Priya Sharma
fields.text: Every visit feels like a celebration. The ambiance is stunning and the Prawns Pulav is absolutely divine. This is our family's go-to restaurant for special occasions.

fields.name: Karthik Nair
fields.text: Godavari Vindu captures the true essence of Andhra cuisine with a luxurious touch. The Chicken Tikka melts in your mouth and the service is impeccable.
